dynamic_universes.match_note: Exact match by game. Kalshi event ticker encodes date+teams (exact team codes taken from market tickers, e.g. KXNFLGAME-26OCT11PHIJAC-PHI -> PHI). Polymarket event via slug nfl-<c1>-<c2>-<yyyy-mm-dd> (code map: JAC->jax) with fallback to gamma public-search by team full names filtered to same date. Side matched by team full name to Polymarket moneyline outcome title. Reference = CLOB buy price of that outcome's YES token.
Same method as NFL; Polymarket MLB slug format unverified, relies on search fallback. Fail soft if unmatchable.

fed_pairs.description: Fed funds upper bound above 4.00% after Oct 28 2026 meeting
fed_pairs.match_note: Derived match: Kalshi threshold ladder vs Polymarket cut-size buckets. Each scan re-derives the current upper bound from the full ladder (first threshold ascending whose mid < 97c; the step below must be ~100c). The pair is only valid if its threshold equals that baseline; then P(upper > T after meeting) == P(hike at that meeting). December Fed omitted: Kalshi Dec thresholds are cumulative across the Oct+Dec meetings while Polymarket Dec buckets describe the December meeting only.
fed_pairs.reference_rule: sum of CLOB YES buy prices of buckets whose title contains 'increase' (case-insensitive) = P(Oct meeting hikes)

notes: NFL/MLB pairs resolve dynamically each scan because games expire weekly; a static ticker list would go stale in days. Fed pair is static but its rate baseline is re-derived from the full Kalshi ladder on every scan (never hardcoded). CPI skipped: Kalshi headline-CPI thresholds have no clean Polymarket match (Core CPI only).
strategy: Cross-market divergence vs Polymarket reference price. Signal when |Kalshi YES mid - reference YES| >= 4c. Paper only.
